description: FPM Levee Banks (DWER-021) is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Water and Environmental Regulation. The Department of Water and Environmental Regulation produces floodplain mapping of rivers and major watercourses and provides floodplain development advice to ensure that proposed floodplain development has adequate flood protection and does not impact on the existing flood regime of the area. This advice is related to major river flooding only. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Water and Environmental Regulation. Its tags are DWER, Flood, Hazards, Water. It offers 8 resource(s) in API ARCGIS SERVER MAP SERVICE, FGDB, GEOJSON, GEOPACKAGE, SHP. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is custom_active_acceptance. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
